title: AMT Controller
text: Automated manual transmission controller with clutch open, close, and synchronization timing, 3 outputs; {Initial gear, G_o} sets the engaged gear, {Clutch actuation time, tc} sets the time .1, {Synchronizer time, ts} sets the time .01, {Sample period, dt} sets the time, {Start simulation with clutch locked} selects to initially lock clutch and {Start simulation with synchronizer locked} selects to initially lock synchronizer. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Start simulation with clutch locked
params.values: Select to initially lock clutch off (default) | on

params.name: Start simulation with synchronizer locked
params.values: Select to initially lock synchronizer off (default) | on
